Name: Emily Fixed Appearance
Author: sayorsuki
Description:
I personally never really like Emily's default appearance, so I decided to change her sprites and portraits to make her more attractive (in my opinion). There are many changes, such as longer sleeves on her wedding dress, fixed eye color on the sprites, a shorter dress, no sleeves on her dress, slightly less saturated hair and paler skin on the sprites themselves. Changes may be suggested, and any errors noticed in the sprites would be appreciated if you find them. Thank you.

To install this mod go into the zipped folder and first go into the Emily (PORTRAITS) folder inside of that. Take the file inside and go into content, then paste it into the portraits folder inside of the stardew valley content folder. Let it overwrite the other one. (backup the original if you intend to change back, or just in case). Then go back to the zipped folder and into the Emily (CHARACTER) folder. Take the file from there and go back to the stardew valley content folder, and find the characters folder. Paste this there and rinse and repeat as before.
